# Najam ul Hassan (najmiter)

> Full stack software developer from Pakistan, building web and mobile apps with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS. Lead developer on Strivio and Kayya at IntelliQuarck; founder of Knoctal, where he ships small, free, privacy-minded tools. Loves math and making games in his free time.

This is the personal portfolio at https://www.najmiter.dev. The home page lists work experience and every project; each project has its own page at `https://www.najmiter.dev/{project-id}` with an overview, feature list, stack, and links to the live product.

- Name: Najam ul Hassan, also known online as `najmiter`
- Role: Full Stack Developer at IntelliQuarck (Jul 2024 – present, remote); Founder & Full Stack Developer at Knoctal (Apr 2021 – present)
- Education: BSCS
- Email: realnajmiter@gmail.com
- Core skills: React.js, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Node.js, Express, NestJS, ASP.NET, Blazor, Razor, Go, Rust, Git

## Work at IntelliQuarck

- [Strivio (web)](https://www.najmiter.dev/strivio): Lead developer on an AI recruiting platform — AI resume parsing, AI-conducted verbal interviews, coding assessments with a built-in editor, and camera/screen proctoring. Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeroUI, Tailwind, shadcn. Live at https://strivio.ai/
- [Strivio (mobile)](https://www.najmiter.dev/strivio-mobile): Interview preparation module — UI and API integration. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.strivio.app
- [Kayya](https://www.najmiter.dev/kayya): Lead developer on an embedded financing platform for service businesses. Built the Next.js/Tailwind frontend and the NestJS/Node.js backend, integrating Stripe, Didit, CRS, and other financial services. Live at https://kayyafinancial.com
- [FltrLnk (mobile)](https://www.najmiter.dev/fltrlnk): Interview preparation module — UI and API integration. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gorkemyagci.ftrlnkmobileapp
- [IntelliQuarck website](https://www.najmiter.dev/intelliquarck): Built the full redesigned company site in Next.js with Framer Motion animations. Live at https://intelliquarck.com/

## Projects at Knoctal

- [Sivi](https://www.najmiter.dev/sivi): Open-source, local-first CV builder — resume data never leaves the browser, no accounts, customizable templates, real-time preview. https://sivi.knoctal.com/
- [PdfRizz](https://www.najmiter.dev/pdfrizz): Free in-browser PDF toolkit — merge, split, insert and remove pages, and convert PDFs to PNG or JPEG. https://pdfrizz.knoctal.com/
- [Lootie](https://www.najmiter.dev/lootie): Free online Lottie JSON editor with a visual property editor and live animation preview. https://lottie.knoctal.com/
- [World Map](https://www.najmiter.dev/world-map): Interactive educational world map — click a country for its continent, flag, capital, and population. https://world-map.knoctal.com/
- [Quvik](https://www.najmiter.dev/quvik): Android study app for matric and intermediate students in Pakistan — past papers, AI-generated quizzes, progress charts, streaks, and reminders. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.najmiter.quvik
- [ClipMac](https://www.najmiter.dev/clipmac): Dockless macOS clipboard history app with a global shortcut (Control+Shift+Space). https://github.com/najmiter/clipmac
- [Spider Solitaire (clone)](https://www.najmiter.dev/spider-solitaire): Browser clone of the Windows XP card game, with full rules and a responsive layout. https://najmiter.github.io/spider-solitaire-clone/
- [DoBurji Welfare Society](https://www.najmiter.dev/doburji): Next.js town welfare platform with a built-in social feed, role-based donation system with automatic image generation, and admin moderation tools. https://www.doburji.com/
- [Beutron](https://www.najmiter.dev/beutron): Next.js inventory management system with a role-based dashboard, subscription plans, and an online storefront for premium users. https://beutron.vercel.app/
- [FontIt](https://www.najmiter.dev/fontit): VS Code extension for changing the editor font family from the command palette. https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=najmiter.fontit
- [Turboin](https://www.najmiter.dev/turboin): Chrome extension for IDE-style tab switching via a command palette, plus extras like a calendar command. https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/turboin/gnonhllejnghekflninibgaohfbbmekc
- [Neutrabize](https://www.najmiter.dev/neutrabize): Chrome extension replacing the new tab page, with geolocation-based weather. https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/neutrabize/ppknddihdfnhmdfloaeamelpinalhppe
- [Chitter](https://www.najmiter.dev/chitter): Assembly language syntax highlighter written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. https://najmiter.github.io/Chitter/
- [UOG LMS Beauty Parlor](https://www.najmiter.dev/uog-lms-beauty-parlor): Chrome extension adding dark mode to the University of Gujrat LMS, with Gemini-powered answer suggestions. https://github.com/najmiter/darkcircles
- [NutNut](https://www.najmiter.dev/nutnut): Subscription-based streaming service built with ASP.NET, Razor Pages, and MSSQL. https://github.com/najmiter/nutnut
